Brand strategy

My Approach to Brand Strategy

Every post has a job: build the brand, earn attention and show up in the numbers.

  1. Stage 1

    Audit

    I review the brand, its past content and its competitors to see what to keep, fix and build on.

  2. Stage 2

    Audience Research

    I research audiences, trends and platform behavior to learn what each channel responds to.

  3. Stage 3

    Brand Positioning

    I set one clear voice and message that ties back to the client’s business goal.

  4. Stage 4

    Content and Campaign Planning

    I build content pillars, formats, creative briefs and a calendar for each platform.

  5. Stage 5

    Creative Execution

    I turn briefs into copy and concepts, coordinate with designers and editors where needed, and publish across platforms.

  6. Stage 6

    Performance Measurement

    I track growth, engagement, reach and views, then feed what works into the next plan.

How I run brand accounts

Brand communication

A consistent voice, look and message across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Content planning

Calendars built around events, seasons and trends, with templates that speed up production.

Creative briefing and direction

Business goals turned into briefs, copy and concepts for Reels, Stories and static posts.

Community management and ORM

Comments and community responses handled to protect trust in the brand.

Performance reporting

Audience growth, engagement, reach and views tracked in Sprout Social, then used to guide the next round of content.

Cross-functional coordination

Feedback, approvals and production coordinated with clients, designers and editors so content goes live on time.

Consumer electronics · Acer Group

AcerPure India

@acerpure_india
Objective
Grow the Instagram audience and brand visibility for a home appliance brand.
Approach
Place each product in a real seasonal moment: a heatwave at home, a rainy-day chore, a monsoon movie night. Pair product-led stories with trends and occasions such as Earth Day and a cricket final.
My role
  • ConceptualizedIdeas for the Instagram Reels and Stories that go live on the account
  • ContributedTrend-led Summer and Monsoon campaigns, from concept to publication
  • ExecutedInstagram account management, Facebook cross-promotion and monthly Instagram performance reporting
